To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
pancreatic fluid collection drainage by endoscopy alone is just as good as drainage by endos-copy plus endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography.
transpapillary pancreatic duct stenting does not provide additional clinical benefit for transmural endoscopic drainage of pancreatic fluid collections (particularly pseudocyst).
pancreatic duct (PD) transpapillary stenting provides no added clinical benefit for the transmural drainage of pancreatic fluid collections.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the endoscopic treatment of pancreatic fluid collections (pancreatic pseudocysts).
the study of pancreatic duct (PD) drainage in the transmural endoscopic drainage of pancreatic fluid collections (FCSs) (pseudocysts).
the endoscopic management for pancreatic fluid collection.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the addition of transpapillary stent placement to transmural drainage does not improve clinical outcomes in patients with pancreatic fluid collections.
the use of PD stent is unnecessary in the TM of PNCs.
there is no advantage to transpapillary pancreatic duct (PD) drainage for the transmural drainage of symptomatic PFCs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
there is no advantage to pancreatic duct stenting for the transmural drainage of pancreatic pseudocysts, and patients undergoing transmural drainage do not require ERCP.
transmural drainage alone is sufficient for most patients with pseudocysts and that pancreatic duct stent placement is not necessary.
there is no advantage to transpapillary pancreatic duct stenting for the transmural endoscopic drainage of pancreatic fluid collections.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there is no added benefit to the combination of transpapillary and transmural pancreatic duct stenting for the treatment of symptomatic pancreatic pseudocysts.
there is no advantage of adding transpapillary pancreatic duct stenting to transmural drainage of pancreatic fluid collections.

the addition of transpapillary pancreatic duct (TPPD) drainage does not improve clinical success rates in the endoscopic transmural drainage of PFCs, including pseudocysts, walled-off necrosis (WON), and pancreatic ascites.
